title: 522. Assign Cookies

examples.explanation: Only one cookie can satisfy a child: one size-1 cookie covers the child with greed 1, and the other cookie is too small for greed 2 or 3.
Hand the size-1 cookie to the first child and the size-2 cookie to the second child.
The two biggest cookies satisfy the two least greedy children.
